title: Is Toeplitz
statementMd:
A matrix is Toeplitz if every diagonal (top-left to bottom-right) has the same value. Return whether it is.

**Example:** `is_toeplitz([[1, 2, 3], [4, 1, 2], [7, 4, 1]])` returns `true`.
hints: Compare each cell with its upper-left neighbour.
referenceSolution:
def is_toeplitz(m):
    return all(m[r][c] == m[r - 1][c - 1] for r in range(1, len(m)) for c in range(1, len(m[0])))
